neighbours.label: saying that something is hard or impossible to do (hard to argue, could not begin to, can't do it, difficult to talk, can't get much closer), as opposed to easy and plain actions
fire: It is really hard to talk people out of that belief.
She could not begin to describe the view from the top.
Oh no. I can't do this. I really can't.
We can't even begin to count how many calls came in.
It is difficult to write about my father.
You can't get much further from the city than this.
It is almost impossible to get a table on Fridays.
Who could say no to a face like that?
quiet: It is really nice to talk with people at the fair.
She began to describe the view from the top.
Oh good. I can do this. I really can.
We count the calls that came in each day.
It is easy to write to my father.
You can get a bus further from the city today.
It is fun to get a table on Fridays.
Who said hello to that man at the door?

short: something is hard or impossible to do
notes: 'Who could ask for anything more' was 0.31 in a probe, so rhetorical questions may be weaker.
